title: Mighty Tieton

services.name: 10 × 10 Small Works Exhibition
services.desc: Come celebrate the 15th 10 x 10 small works exhibition. Artwork from all over the country and the world. No larger than 10 x 10 x 10 inches! Reception on Saturday, August 3 noon - 3. More information here. Would you like to received weekly notices about events and news about Tieton? Send your name and email address and we will put you on the mailing list. Tours of the studios are held on most Saturdays. Meet up at Boxx Gallery at 11 on Saturdays. $10 donation to Friends of Boxx Gallery. Children under 12 are free. blurb: In some ways, Tieton is the quintessential small agricultural town. In others, Tieton is a remarkable story of community connection and realignment to benefit from contemporary economic opportunities.
